Paupers Graves

By: Liz Fish | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The box of ashes you are holding of your loved one turns out not to be them at all - what happened to their body?

Unique Selling Point:
Imagine going through the grief of losing your loved one, the funeral is over, and the undertaker delivers you a box of ashes with your loved one’s name and details on it. 5 months later two officials from the City of Cape Town arrive at your door to say that’s not your mothers ashes, she is buried in a pauper’s grave. They leave with the ashes telling you to open a case of fraud at the local police station.
This has happened to 12 families that we know of all by the same undertaker. They have nothing. They can’t memorialise the grave which the City has identified, because it’s a pauper or public grave which can be reuse in 5 years, if needs be. The bodies can’t be exhumed until the state signs the exhumation order. The families can’t exhume the bodies, and the City nor the state are coming up with the funds, or the order. It’s been going on for a year and the families can’t find closure. The City who accepted the fraudulent burial documents, and are the responsible authority are now stone walling the families.


Summary:
Pertus Booysen of St Francis Funeral services has buried 11 bodies that we know of in paupers’ graves, after having charged the families for cremations and delivered them a box of ashes. But he failed to issue them cremation certificates, and most people are unaware that they are entitled to one. Or issued fraudulent cremation certificates
A second funeral service company Javis funerals in Kuils River is also implicated yet has not been charged and appears to have worked in cahoots with Petrus Booysen. Not only is Javis scamming the families but also the Old Apostolic church who held the funeral policies. Javis claimed additional expenses for a bus to transport relatives and the burial of a body when in fact they delivered ashes to the family. Javis transported 5 bodies to Welmoed graveyard for Booysen yet claims he did not know that the one body was in fact somebody he said he had cremated months earlier.
One frail elderly man sits with a box of ashes that he believes is his wife who he was married to for 51 years. His daughter refused to hand over the ashes to the City because she can’t bear to take him through this saga. She only found out when she followed up with the City after reading about it in the newspaper. That’s when 6 new cases were discovered, but how long has Petrus Booysen been at this? And what is the business model?
The graveyards fall under the Cities administration, and they accepted the fraudulent documents. But apart from informing the families, removing the ashes and instructing the families to open criminal cases, a year later they refuse to engage.
Monica Muller- both her parents died 6 weeks apart. Her fathers ashes have the crematorium tag so she knows they are her fathers ashes, but her mother ashes are what appears to be wood ash and her body was never booked out the mortuary. But the mortuary closed down and nobody will tell her where her mother is? The City cant find any record of her burial. She lives down the road from Petrus Booysen and is prepared to go confront him.


Further information:
Anita Momberg and 11 other families that we know of are left in this horrible limbo. They have no ashes, they don’t know if that really is their loved one in the pauper grave and the City is stone walling them after the initial contact, and the case was taken off the court roll this week. The investigating office Capt. Williams has been transferred so they are left hanging. Booysen is still burying bodies in Welmoed cemetery, but under a different funeral parlor name. If and when the bodies do get exhumed the state will pay for the DNA tests, but the families will have to pay again to have them cremated.
The families are willing to go on camera. Susan Brice the Head of City Parks needs to be confronted. We have the address of Petrus Booysen and Javis funerals so we can confront them. I have interviewed the federation of funerals who are willing to go on camera and unpack what should happen and what unscrupulous funeral parlors stand to gain from this. With the case struck off the roll this week to give the state more time to investigate so it gives us more flexibility.

Press Release:


Families in mourning receive shocking news: the remains they’ve received are not their loved ones. Are these the ashes of a stranger, or something else entirely? And where are the bodies buried? A year ago, a dozen grieving families were alerted to an alleged funeral services scam involving faked documents, mystery ashes – and a burial in a paupers’ grave. But a year later, city officials are no longer taking their calls. As families remain in painful limbo, unable to exhume their relatives or even mark their final resting places, Carte Blanche asks: who is responsible? And how can these families find closure?

Script:


VO: Freda Fortune and her late mother were close.
Freda: She stayed with us since we got married for 35 years, she reared my children
VO: She died last year, leaving behind 3 children and 23 grand, and great children.
PAUSE
When they applied for permission to bury her mother's ashes in the family grave at Maitland Cemetery in Cape Town, their mourning - turned into despair.
Freda “This is where she should have been in the 1st place.
VO: And they weren’t alone.
Anita “ This is not where she belongs - it’s not the promise I made to my mother
VO: 11 families searching for answers. Their loved ones in unmarked graves.
Anita “…she is not supposed to be here
VO: Faked certificates… missing bodies.… unknown ashes.
Sharivonne “We don't even know if it's human ashes. We don't even know that.
Freda’ “She shouldn't have been buried she should have been cremated
Fade to Black
VO: Freda has been a funeral florist for more than 20 years; experience she relied on - when choosing an undertaker.
Freda: He would order beautiful flowers for his funerals, never cheap,.And those are little things I didn't see from all of my hundred plus undertakers I worked for.
VO: At first, things went smoothly. Freda recalls a beautiful funeral and her mother’s ashes were delivered for burial, by the undertaker.
PAUSE
VO: But, when officials asked Freda for her mother’s cremation certificate, things began to unravel.
Freda: You need a permit. You need to go through the booking office, pay the fee for the opening of the grave. They came back and said we're missing the cremation certificate.
VO: A cremation certificate is supplied by the crematorium showing the date of cremation, and a number that correlates to a tag accompanying the ashes.
When Freda enquired, she was sent three different cremation certificates on the same day by the undertaker. It didn’t make sense, and Freda grew suspicious, She called the crematorium.
Freda: The lady starts crying - is there something you want to tell me and I say yes and she says .Your mother was never cremated, and I just broke down. and I just said, I want to know where my mother is.
VO: Shocked by the news, she tried to figure out what had happened to her mother. What she discovered - would set in motion an investigation by the City of Cape Town, and turn the worlds of several other families upside down. At the centre of it all - was undertaker - Petrus Booysen of St Francis funerals
Breather
Link “ These two are unmarked graves, this is 1272 , 1275, I am looking for grave 1269 this is the grave the City of Cape Town says that Freda’s mother is buried in
VO: If there’s a ‘ground zero’ in this investigation, Cape Town’s Welmoed Cemetery is it. It’s where the City tells us Booysen buried not only Freda’s mother, but five others in pauper’s graves. All of them were buried on the same day.
Anita “They are supposed to be all buried next to each other, there is 5 burials on the same day with 5 family members and when I came here - well I was told that is my mothers grave.
VO: Paupers’ graves are unmarked and used for unidentified bodies or people who can’t afford a gravesite. Anita Momberg’s mother was neither of those – nor was she a man called Clive.
Anita: in graveyard” Clearly and she has never been Clive Morris, and the graveyard manager went into action mode, whatsapping his, and that's when he came with that spike and he was digging -we don’t know if she is in the correct grave and if it is her in that grave is.
VO: The City called 5 months after she had received what she believed were her mother’s ashes
Anita ”The head of compliance for the City of Cape Town contacted me and advised me that my mom was in fact buried and not cremated.
VO: Worse still, the pauper’s grave where her mother lies is temporary: the City can reuse it after five years.
Anita “. I'm not allowed to memorialize it. And ultimately, that's not what my promise to my mom was. That was not her dying wish
VO: The City of Cape Town is responsible for the Maitland Crematorium, and the graveyards. It was while investigating Freda’s case - that they discovered the other burials.
PAUSE
And Booysen was central to all five..
Anita “I experienced him as a very pleasant, upstanding citizen that helped many families through a traumatic time. I'm still at a loss for words.
VO: The City informed all the affected families - those they’ve been able to identify - and advised them to lay charges against Booysen. Then, Anita says, they simply stopped communicating.
Anita: Why come and see me and advise me that this has happened, and then completely leave me destitute to try and navigate a system that I don't understand. I was under the impression that the city was going to support us in finding justice.

VO: Without official support, the families took matters into their own hands. Forming a support group, they applied for access to crucial documentation, and discovered Booysen’s victims, included at least another six families.
Monica: SUBS: When I read it, I just thought — please, don’t let it not have been my parents — that’s all that went through my mind.
VO: Monica Muller's parents died within 5 weeks of each other last year. She got wind of the controversy surrounding Booysen, in “Die Son” newspaper
Monica: SUBS: I immediately jumped in and started making enquiries on my own. I phoned everyone I could phone to find out whether my parents might have also fallen into the trap.
VO: The truth was sickening.
It turns out that these are her father’s ashes - but for some reason - Booysen gave her fraudulent cremation certificates - for both her parents.
Upsound Monica “the documents for both my parents are forgeries, I have no idea why my fathers certificate is also falsified. They did, however contact me to say - however both the certificates are incorrect because it does not correspond to the information which we have on the deceased
VO: While investigating, she learnt the only way to ensure the proper identity of ashes - is to check that the number on the accompanying metal tag - matches the one on the genuine cremation certificate.
Monica “ This number 110094 corresponds with the plaques number
VO: That means her dad’s ashes are genuine.
When she compared them, it became clear what she was told were her mother’s ashes were not. Nor, she says, were they human.
Monica” This is what my mother’s ashes look like
Erin “ it looks like sawdust or something
Monica “ It smells like sawdust
Erin: And there is not plaque either right
Monica” No, there is nothing in the box
VO: The City confirmed there was no record of her mother’s grave. Monica, like Freda, Anita and the other family members, tried to piece together, a complex puzzle.
breather
It emerged Booysen isn’t registered with the City, bought public plots without the families consent, and entered City graveyards - with blatantly forged documents.
The document was meant for somebody else- for Dorothea Beukes, …and he just scratched out
Erin “He being Petrus Booysen
Wendy” Yes, Petrus just scratched out and put in Rachel, my grandmas details, on the same document. How many people are buried in that grave? Dorathea or Rachel or both of them?
VO: In other words, it appears Booysen was recycling a document detailing where and when the deceased was buried; and the same unmarked graves - were being used over - and over again.
Breather
VO: So we went in search of Dorothy Beukes’s family. But, rather than providing clarity, our investigation took another, unexpected turn.
Sharivonne: they use a person called Petrus Booysen to do their cremations because they do not have access to Maitland Crematorium
VO: Sharivonne Rudolph is Dorothy’s niece. When her aunt died, the family appointed a company called Jarvis Funerals. And yet, they found themselves dragged into the Petrus Booysen saga… because Jarvis subcontracted him.
Sharivonne: How can anyone be so heartless? How would they feel if someone so close to them were to be thrown away like a dog?
Erin: I just want to show you something.
Okay.
This is a copy of a document from the City of Cape Town. And as you can see, your aunt's name is here …
Sharivonne: Okay. St Francis, yes
Erin. He reused the paperwork for your aunt to put her in that pauper's grave at Welmoed , scratched out her name, and put the name of another deceased that he was supposed to cremate.
Sharivonne: So the chances are that they are two bodies in that grave
Erin: We don't know. we simply dont know
Sharivonne: Wow.
Sharivonne: what did he gain with all of this? Because obviously this was a moneymaking business, but it's undignified.
VO: It appears Booysen capitalises on few people knowing that ashes should come with a cremation certificate. And if they ask, he sends fraudulent ones.
How many bodies has Booysen buried - and how long has he been getting away with it?
Breather – Erin driving
LINK : This is a side of the funeral industry that few of us will get to see, a mortuary in the middle of an industrial area, next to scarp metal yard and furniture warehouses, it's actually quite shocking
VO Booysen doesn’t have his own funeral parlour, he stores bodies in various commercial mortuaries across Cape Town
Freda’s investigation led her here.
Freda “ This used to be the M mortuary you can still see the sign,
My mother was stored here, he brought her to the church, I identified her at the church, the Saturday the 24th August, and from church she came back here
LINK “By September of last year the mortuary in this office park had to close down, Javis and Booysen were under pressure to move the bodies, but the question is where did they take them?
Upsound” Monica” I asked the M mortuary to send me the registers to show my mother was there.
VO: Monica’s detective work uncovered the mortuary records – she found the date her mother arrived - but - she was never signed out
Monica” 8 bodies on 18th there were 8 bodies signed out of the mortuary, but on the 19 there were 9 bodies taken out of the mortuary, they think my mother was the one but no record of who, and her suspicion is that my mothers body was that was not signed out one
VO: And Freda’s mother, meanwhile, was still in the mortuary - despite the City’s own records - showing she’d been buried.
Two missing bodies, and two daughters anxiously trying to figure out - what happened to them.
Freda: Isn't she just lying at Strandfontein where he just dumped her or something.
Breather
VO: The families have tried their best to figure out Booysen’s modus operandi. When Monica tried calling him, he simply ignored her. But, facing claims of such seriousness and with several families desperate for information on their departed loved ones, we attempted - to get him on camera.
Pause
Our producer lured him - with the promise of more work.
Booysen’ The consent forms the family must sign mos.You see I signed because I couldn’t get hold of the father an ja but I did give it to the cemetery.
Sorry man, I am so busy. let me just let me just
VO: As we’d investigated, a clearer picture of Booysen had emerged. He’s a former policeman, arrested earlier this year on charges of fraud. Released on bail without conditions, and it seems it’s business as usual.
Booysen “I pick up the body, I keep the remains by me,
Producer”Where is you
Booysen”There at Blackheath
Producer “Where is Blackheath
Booysen” There in Kuils River-
Producer” But is it your parlour, your funeral parlour-
Booysen” Yes its mine
Breather in graveyard
VO: The City of Cape Town refused an on camera interview - saying it was an ongoing police matter in which they were fully co-operating, and condemned these unscrupulous acts.
Anita: “It just feels to me like they want this to go away none of them responded to any of the communications that I've issued, only very recently after your intervention, issued correspondence for my attention
VO: And things haven’t progressed for the families in court either. The State took so long to get an exhumation order, the family’s case against Booysen was struck off the roll last month, and they can’t exhume the bodies privately.
Anita: My mom's ashes was confiscated. I've got nothing. I haven't got a body.
Freda” Mothers day I didn't even go to church, I couldn't , her 1st mothers day not here, and me not knowing where she is
breather
Anita “The undertaker needs to be prosecuted, but the city needs to be held accountable for processes that they did not follow.
Sharivonne: How did this happen? How did City of Cape Town just let this slide? The police have failed us, the justice system has failed us, and the City of Cape Town failed us.
Breather
VO: There’ll be no closure until the bodies are exhumed. Monica and her siblings hope to scatter their parents’ ashes at sea. As what would have been their 40th wedding anniversary approaches - she’s unsure - whether that’ll happen.

Unique Selling Point: Imagine going through the grief of losing your loved one, the funeral is over, and the undertaker delivers you a box of ashes with your loved one’s name and details on it. 5 months later two officials from the City of Cape Town arrive at your door to say that’s not your mothers ashes, she is buried in a pauper’s grave. They leave with the ashes telling you to open a case of fraud at the local police station. This has happened to 12 families that we know of all by the same undertaker. They have nothing. They can’t memorialise the grave which the City has identified, because it’s a pauper or public grave which can be reuse in 5 years, if needs be. The bodies can’t be exhumed until the state signs the exhumation order. The families can’t exhume the bodies, and the City nor the state are coming up with the funds, or the order. It’s been going on for a year and the families can’t find closure. The City who accepted the fraudulent burial documents, and are the responsible authority are now stone walling the families. Summary: Pertus Booysen of St Francis Funeral services has buried 11 bodies that we know of in paupers’ graves, after having charged the families for cremations and delivered them a box of ashes. But he failed to issue them cremation certificates, and most people are unaware that they are entitled to one. Or issued fraudulent cremation certificates A second funeral service company Javis funerals in Kuils River is also implicated yet has not been charged and appears to have worked in cahoots with Petrus Booysen. Not only is Javis scamming the families but also the Old Apostolic church who held the funeral policies. Javis claimed additional expenses for a bus to transport relatives and the burial of a body when in fact they delivered ashes to the family. Javis transported 5 bodies to Welmoed graveyard for Booysen yet claims he did not know that the one body was in fact somebody he said he had cremated months earlier. One frail elderly man sits with a box of ashes that he believes is his wife who he was married to for 51 years. His daughter refused to hand over the ashes to the City because she can’t bear to take him through this saga. She only found out when she followed up with the City after reading about it in the newspaper. That’s when 6 new cases were discovered, but how long has Petrus Booysen been at this? And what is the business model? The graveyards fall under the Cities administration, and they accepted the fraudulent documents. But apart from informing the families, removing the ashes and instructing the families to open criminal cases, a year later they refuse to engage. Monica Muller- both her parents died 6 weeks apart. Her fathers ashes have the crematorium tag so she knows they are her fathers ashes, but her mother ashes are what appears to be wood ash and her body was never booked out the mortuary. But the mortuary closed down and nobody will tell her where her mother is? The City cant find any record of her burial. She lives down the road from Petrus Booysen and is prepared to go confront him. Further information: Anita Momberg and 11 other families that we know of are left in this horrible limbo. They have no ashes, they don’t know if that really is their loved one in the pauper grave and the City is stone walling them after the initial contact, and the case was taken off the court roll this week. The investigating office Capt. Williams has been transferred so they are left hanging. Booysen is still burying bodies in Welmoed cemetery, but under a different funeral parlor name. If and when the bodies do get exhumed the state will pay for the DNA tests, but the families will have to pay again to have them cremated. The families are willing to go on camera. Susan Brice the Head of City Parks needs to be confronted. We have the address of Petrus Booysen and Javis funerals so we can confront them. I have interviewed the federation of funerals who are willing to go on camera and unpack what should happen and what unscrupulous funeral parlors stand to gain from this. With the case struck off the roll this week to give the state more time to investigate so it gives us more flexibility. TX Date: 0000-00-00 Press Release: Families in mourning receive shocking news: the remains they’ve received are not their loved ones. Are these the ashes of a stranger, or something else entirely? And where are the bodies buried? A year ago, a dozen grieving families were alerted to an alleged funeral services scam involving faked documents, mystery ashes – and a burial in a paupers’ grave. But a year later, city officials are no longer taking their calls. As families remain in painful limbo, unable to exhume their relatives or even mark their final resting places, Carte Blanche asks: who is responsible? And how can these families find closure? Script: VO: Freda Fortune and her late mother were close. Freda: She stayed with us since we got married for 35 years, she reared my children VO: She died last year, leaving behind 3 children and 23 grand, and great children. PAUSE When they applied for permission to bury her mother's ashes in the family grave at Maitland Cemetery in Cape Town, their mourning - turned into despair. Freda “This is where she should have been in the 1st place. VO: And they weren’t alone. Anita “ This is not where she belongs - it’s not the promise I made to my mother VO: 11 families searching for answers. Their loved ones in unmarked graves. Anita “…she is not supposed to be here VO: Faked certificates… missing bodies.… unknown ashes. Sharivonne “We don't even know if it's human ashes. We don't even know that. Freda’ “She shouldn't have been buried she should have been cremated Fade to Black VO: Freda has been a funeral florist for more than 20 years; experience she relied on - when choosing an undertaker. Freda: He would order beautiful flowers for his funerals, never cheap,.And those are little things I didn't see from all of my hundred plus undertakers I worked for. VO: At first, things went smoothly. Freda recalls a beautiful funeral and her mother’s ashes were delivered for burial, by the undertaker. PAUSE VO: But, when officials asked Freda for her mother’s cremation certificate, things began to unravel. Freda: You need a permit. You need to go through the booking office, pay the fee for the opening of the grave. They came back and said we're missing the cremation certificate. VO: A cremation certificate is supplied by the crematorium showing the date of cremation, and a number that correlates to a tag accompanying the ashes. When Freda enquired, she was sent three different cremation certificates on the same day by the undertaker. It didn’t make sense, and Freda grew suspicious, She called the crematorium. Freda: The lady starts crying - is there something you want to tell me and I say yes and she says .Your mother was never cremated, and I just broke down. and I just said, I want to know where my mother is. VO: Shocked by the news, she tried to figure out what had happened to her mother. What she discovered - would set in motion an investigation by the City of Cape Town, and turn the worlds of several other families upside down. At the centre of it all - was undertaker - Petrus Booysen of St Francis funerals Breather Link “ These two are unmarked graves, this is 1272 , 1275, I am looking for grave 1269 this is the grave the City of Cape Town says that Freda’s mother is buried in VO: If there’s a ‘ground zero’ in this investigation, Cape Town’s Welmoed Cemetery is it. It’s where the City tells us Booysen buried not only Freda’s mother, but five others in pauper’s graves. All of them were buried on the same day. Anita “They are supposed to be all buried next to each other, there is 5 burials on the same day with 5 family members and when I came here - well I was told that is my mothers grave. VO: Paupers’ graves are unmarked and used for unidentified bodies or people who can’t afford a gravesite. Anita Momberg’s mother was neither of those – nor was she a man called Clive. Anita: in graveyard” Clearly and she has never been Clive Morris, and the graveyard manager went into action mode, whatsapping his, and that's when he came with that spike and he was digging -we don’t know if she is in the correct grave and if it is her in that grave is. VO: The City called 5 months after she had received what she believed were her mother’s ashes Anita ”The head of compliance for the City of Cape Town contacted me and advised me that my mom was in fact buried and not cremated. VO: Worse still, the pauper’s grave where her mother lies is temporary: the City can reuse it after five years. Anita “. I'm not allowed to memorialize it. And ultimately, that's not what my promise to my mom was. That was not her dying wish VO: The City of Cape Town is responsible for the Maitland Crematorium, and the graveyards. It was while investigating Freda’s case - that they discovered the other burials. PAUSE And Booysen was central to all five.. Anita “I experienced him as a very pleasant, upstanding citizen that helped many families through a traumatic time. I'm still at a loss for words. VO: The City informed all the affected families - those they’ve been able to identify - and advised them to lay charges against Booysen. Then, Anita says, they simply stopped communicating. Anita: Why come and see me and advise me that this has happened, and then completely leave me destitute to try and navigate a system that I don't understand. I was under the impression that the city was going to support us in finding justice. VO: Without official support, the families took matters into their own hands. Forming a support group, they applied for access to crucial documentation, and discovered Booysen’s victims, included at least another six families. Monica: SUBS: When I read it, I just thought — please, don’t let it not have been my parents — that’s all that went through my mind. VO: Monica Muller's parents died within 5 weeks of each other last year. She got wind of the controversy surrounding Booysen, in “Die Son” newspaper Monica: SUBS: I immediately jumped in and started making enquiries on my own. I phoned everyone I could phone to find out whether my parents might have also fallen into the trap. VO: The truth was sickening. It turns out that these are her father’s ashes - but for some reason - Booysen gave her fraudulent cremation certificates - for both her parents. Upsound Monica “the documents for both my parents are forgeries, I have no idea why my fathers certificate is also falsified. They did, however contact me to say - however both the certificates are incorrect because it does not correspond to the information which we have on the deceased VO: While investigating, she learnt the only way to ensure the proper identity of ashes - is to check that the number on the accompanying metal tag - matches the one on the genuine cremation certificate. Monica “ This number 110094 corresponds with the plaques number VO: That means her dad’s ashes are genuine. When she compared them, it became clear what she was told were her mother’s ashes were not. Nor, she says, were they human. Monica” This is what my mother’s ashes look like Erin “ it looks like sawdust or something Monica “ It smells like sawdust Erin: And there is not plaque either right Monica” No, there is nothing in the box VO: The City confirmed there was no record of her mother’s grave. Monica, like Freda, Anita and the other family members, tried to piece together, a complex puzzle. breather It emerged Booysen isn’t registered with the City, bought public plots without the families consent, and entered City graveyards - with blatantly forged documents. The document was meant for somebody else- for Dorothea Beukes, …and he just scratched out Erin “He being Petrus Booysen Wendy” Yes, Petrus just scratched out and put in Rachel, my grandmas details, on the same document. How many people are buried in that grave? Dorathea or Rachel or both of them? VO: In other words, it appears Booysen was recycling a document detailing where and when the deceased was buried; and the same unmarked graves - were being used over - and over again. Breather VO: So we went in search of Dorothy Beukes’s family. But, rather than providing clarity, our investigation took another, unexpected turn. Sharivonne: they use a person called Petrus Booysen to do their cremations because they do not have access to Maitland Crematorium VO: Sharivonne Rudolph is Dorothy’s niece. When her aunt died, the family appointed a company called Jarvis Funerals. And yet, they found themselves dragged into the Petrus Booysen saga… because Jarvis subcontracted him. Sharivonne: How can anyone be so heartless? How would they feel if someone so close to them were to be thrown away like a dog? Erin: I just want to show you something. Okay. This is a copy of a document from the City of Cape Town. And as you can see, your aunt's name is here … Sharivonne: Okay. St Francis, yes Erin. He reused the paperwork for your aunt to put her in that pauper's grave at Welmoed , scratched out her name, and put the name of another deceased that he was supposed to cremate. Sharivonne: So the chances are that they are two bodies in that grave Erin: We don't know. we simply dont know Sharivonne: Wow. Sharivonne: what did he gain with all of this? Because obviously this was a moneymaking business, but it's undignified. VO: It appears Booysen capitalises on few people knowing that ashes should come with a cremation certificate. And if they ask, he sends fraudulent ones. How many bodies has Booysen buried - and how long has he been getting away with it? Breather – Erin driving LINK : This is a side of the funeral industry that few of us will get to see, a mortuary in the middle of an industrial area, next to scarp metal yard and furniture warehouses, it's actually quite shocking VO Booysen doesn’t have his own funeral parlour, he stores bodies in various commercial mortuaries across Cape Town Freda’s investigation led her here. Freda “ This used to be the M mortuary you can still see the sign, My mother was stored here, he brought her to the church, I identified her at the church, the Saturday the 24th August, and from church she came back here LINK “By September of last year the mortuary in this office park had to close down, Javis and Booysen were under pressure to move the bodies, but the question is where did they take them? Upsound” Monica” I asked the M mortuary to send me the registers to show my mother was there. VO: Monica’s detective work uncovered the mortuary records – she found the date her mother arrived - but - she was never signed out Monica” 8 bodies on 18th there were 8 bodies signed out of the mortuary, but on the 19 there were 9 bodies taken out of the mortuary, they think my mother was the one but no record of who, and her suspicion is that my mothers body was that was not signed out one VO: And Freda’s mother, meanwhile, was still in the mortuary - despite the City’s own records - showing she’d been buried. Two missing bodies, and two daughters anxiously trying to figure out - what happened to them. Freda: Isn't she just lying at Strandfontein where he just dumped her or something. Breather VO: The families have tried their best to figure out Booysen’s modus operandi. When Monica tried calling him, he simply ignored her. But, facing claims of such seriousness and with several families desperate for information on their departed loved ones, we attempted - to get him on camera. Pause Our producer lured him - with the promise of more work. Booysen’ The consent forms the family must sign mos.You see I signed because I couldn’t get hold of the father an ja but I did give it to the cemetery. Sorry man, I am so busy. let me just let me just VO: As we’d investigated, a clearer picture of Booysen had emerged. He’s a former policeman, arrested earlier this year on charges of fraud. Released on bail without conditions, and it seems it’s business as usual. Booysen “I pick up the body, I keep the remains by me, Producer”Where is you Booysen”There at Blackheath Producer “Where is Blackheath Booysen” There in Kuils River- Producer” But is it your parlour, your funeral parlour- Booysen” Yes its mine Breather in graveyard VO: The City of Cape Town refused an on camera interview - saying it was an ongoing police matter in which they were fully co-operating, and condemned these unscrupulous acts. Anita: “It just feels to me like they want this to go away none of them responded to any of the communications that I've issued, only very recently after your intervention, issued correspondence for my attention VO: And things haven’t progressed for the families in court either. The State took so long to get an exhumation order, the family’s case against Booysen was struck off the roll last month, and they can’t exhume the bodies privately. Anita: My mom's ashes was confiscated. I've got nothing. I haven't got a body. Freda” Mothers day I didn't even go to church, I couldn't , her 1st mothers day not here, and me not knowing where she is breather Anita “The undertaker needs to be prosecuted, but the city needs to be held accountable for processes that they did not follow. Sharivonne: How did this happen? How did City of Cape Town just let this slide? The police have failed us, the justice system has failed us, and the City of Cape Town failed us. Breather VO: There’ll be no closure until the bodies are exhumed. Monica and her siblings hope to scatter their parents’ ashes at sea. As what would have been their 40th wedding anniversary approaches - she’s unsure - whether that’ll happen.

metadata.Summary: Pertus Booysen of St Francis Funeral services has buried 11 bodies that we know of in paupers’ graves, after having charged the families for cremations and delivered them a box of ashes. But he failed to issue them cremation certificates, and most people are unaware that they are entitled to one. Or issued fraudulent cremation certificates A second funeral service company Javis funerals in Kuils River is also implicated yet has not been charged and appears to have worked in cahoots with Petrus Booysen. Not only is Javis scamming the families but also the Old Apostolic church who held the funeral policies. Javis claimed additional expenses for a bus to transport relatives and the burial of a body when in fact they delivered ashes to the family. Javis transported 5 bodies to Welmoed graveyard for Booysen yet claims he did not know that the one body was in fact somebody he said he had cremated months earlier. One frail elderly man sits with a box of ashes that he believes is his wife who he was married to for 51 years. His daughter refused to hand over the ashes to the City because she can’t bear to take him through this saga. She only found out when she followed up with the City after reading about it in the newspaper. That’s when 6 new cases were discovered, but how long has Petrus Booysen been at this? And what is the business model? The graveyards fall under the Cities administration, and they accepted the fraudulent documents. But apart from informing the families, removing the ashes and instructing the families to open criminal cases, a year later they refuse to engage. Monica Muller- both her parents died 6 weeks apart. Her fathers ashes have the crematorium tag so she knows they are her fathers ashes, but her mother ashes are what appears to be wood ash and her body was never booked out the mortuary. But the mortuary closed down and nobody will tell her where her mother is? The City cant find any record of her burial. She lives down the road from Petrus Booysen and is prepared to go confront him.
metadata.Further information: Anita Momberg and 11 other families that we know of are left in this horrible limbo. They have no ashes, they don’t know if that really is their loved one in the pauper grave and the City is stone walling them after the initial contact, and the case was taken off the court roll this week. The investigating office Capt. Williams has been transferred so they are left hanging. Booysen is still burying bodies in Welmoed cemetery, but under a different funeral parlor name. If and when the bodies do get exhumed the state will pay for the DNA tests, but the families will have to pay again to have them cremated. The families are willing to go on camera. Susan Brice the Head of City Parks needs to be confronted. We have the address of Petrus Booysen and Javis funerals so we can confront them. I have interviewed the federation of funerals who are willing to go on camera and unpack what should happen and what unscrupulous funeral parlors stand to gain from this. With the case struck off the roll this week to give the state more time to investigate so it gives us more flexibility.
